LanguageData.Raven_Building_DuskWorkbench.label: [Raven] Dusk Workbench
LanguageData.Raven_Building_DuskWorkbench.description: A slender, streamlined workbench specifically designed for processing Raven Darkfeather Steel and light-sensitive materials. The tabletop is made of special light-absorbing material and is equipped with precise optical calibration instruments.\n\nIt can be used to craft Raven Dark-Sun Lenses and other precision components involving light and shadow conversion.
